description: This file manages authentication profiles, including functions for deduplication, setting profile order, upserting profiles, listing profiles for a provider, and marking profiles as good. It interacts with external modules for normalization, storage, and locking mechanisms.

methods.name: dedupeProfileIds
methods.description: Removes duplicate profile IDs from an array.

methods.name: setAuthProfileOrder
methods.description: Sets the order of profiles for a specific provider, updating the store with locking.

methods.name: upsertAuthProfile
methods.description: Inserts or updates an authentication profile in the store, normalizing secret inputs.

methods.name: upsertAuthProfileWithLock
methods.description: Updates an auth profile in the store with locking, ensuring atomicity.

methods.name: listProfilesForProvider
methods.description: Lists profile IDs associated with a specific provider.

methods.name: markAuthProfileGood
methods.description: Marks a profile as good for a provider, updating the lastGood field with locking.
